name: Ohio
notes: Ohio supports digital ID in Apple Wallet. Google Wallet and Samsung Wallet are not currently supported.

wallets.name: Apple Wallet
steps: Open the Wallet app on your iPhone (iOS 15.4 or later required).
Tap the + button and choose 'Driver's License or State ID'.
Select Ohio from the state list.
Scan the front and back of your Ohio driver's license or ID card.
Complete the face and motion scan to verify your identity.
Your request is sent to the Ohio BMV. You'll receive a notification once approved — usually within a few minutes.
